a11y.text: Tiles are sections named by their h3: BigNumber from chart-kit (the first tile is inverted), area-chart with a compare series, a dial from 0 to 100 with a percent suffix (a read-only meter), and transaction-list. See their notes. The screen adds no controls; area-chart is its only Tab stop.
